text: The combination of HIV, noncompliance, and disseminated white matter lesions is highly suggestive of HIV Encephalopathy or Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy. speaker: Doctor
text:
The extremely low CD4 count of 56/μL in the context of disseminated non-enhancing white matter lesions is diagnostic for Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).
